prompts.name: literature_review
prompts.description: Survey a topic: main themes, foundational vs recent work, open gaps.

arguments.name: venues
arguments.description: Comma-separated venue short names, e.g. NeurIPS,ICML.

arguments.name: since_year
arguments.description: Only consider papers from this year onward.

prompts.name: find_related_work
prompts.description: From an abstract, find and group prior work to cite and how yours differs.

prompts.name: compare_papers
prompts.description: Build a structured comparison table read from each paper's full text.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: A topic or a list of paper titles.

prompts.name: verify_draft
prompts.description: Check each claim in a draft against the corpus, with a quote where one exists.

arguments.name: draft
arguments.description: Draft text or a list of claims.

prompts.name: trace_citations
prompts.description: Trace a paper's lineage: what it built on, what built on it, adjacent work.

prompts.name: research_methodology
prompts.description: Grounded advice on experiment design, ablations, evaluation, rebuttals, venue choice.
